description: This is a PHP unit test class for AbstractLeaveAllocationService in the Leave Service of the OrangeHRM system. The file contains test methods verifying behavior of date and time calculation methods in the leave allocation service, using data providers for different scenarios.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing AbstractLeaveAllocationService's time-related methods within the Leave module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: testAddHoursDuration
methods.description: Tests the addHoursDuration method for correct addition of hours to a DateTime object.

methods.name: getAddHoursDurationDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for testAddHoursDuration, including initial time, hours to add, and expected result.

methods.name: testGetDurationInHours
methods.description: Tests the getDurationInHours method for accurate duration calculation between two DateTime instances.

methods.name: getDurationInHoursDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test cases for getDurationInHours, with start and end times and expected duration.
